name: Classes Immediately Below and Above Maximum Ancestry
statement: The established chain is $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{amp}}\subsetneq\mathcal P_D\subseteq\mathcal D_{\mathrm{amp}}\cap\mathsf{MaxMin}\subsetneq\mathsf{MaxMin}\subseteq\mathsf{Ext}\subseteq\mathsf{Rep}\subseteq\mathcal A$, and $\mathcal B\subsetneq\mathsf{Ext}$. The dismantlable-parent class $\mathcal P_D$ is closed under nonempty pc-minors and full reductions but not complement; $\mathsf{Ext}$ is closed under those operations and complement after adjoining the empty boundary case.
proof: Generic affine arrangements give dismantlable maximum parents for realizable classes, and sections of dismantlable classes stay dismantlable. A maximum parent and its complementary maximum class give representation maps on both marked shores, which is the universal-extension criterion. Hall's complement lies in $\mathcal P_D$ but is not realizable; Hall's class is maximum but not dismantlable and lies in $\mathsf{Ext}\setminus\mathcal B$. Commuting marks with projections, conditionings, and reductions proves closure for $\mathcal P_D$; forward-invariant unique-sink cube orientations prove closure for $\mathsf{Ext}$.
